what_to_ask: What is the hard outdoor sound curfew time?
Is there a dedicated backup generator included for stage AV?
What are the parking capacity and valet arrangements?

Bridal/VIP green room availability with air conditioning and lockable storage
Security guards and perimeter management staff

vendor_checklists.draft_inquiry_message: Hello! We are planning a 40-guest birthday in Pune on 2026-12-05. We would love to enquire about venue availability, hall rental packages, sound limits, and catering guidelines. Please share your brochure and booking terms.

what_to_ask: Can you accommodate our veg dietary preferences with dedicated separate cooking stations?

Live cooking station fire safety compliance
negotiation_tips: Request complimentary welcome drink mocktails or tea/coffee counters
Negotiate free plate count for children under 6 years
red_flags: Refusal to let client inspect their central commercial kitchen
Vague pricing that excludes serving staff or ice bucket charges

what_to_ask: How many photographers and cinematographers will be present on-site?
What is the turnaround time for teaser photos vs full edited cinematic film?

Drone flight permissions in the venue's airspace

Bundle pre-event photoshoot into the total contract

Unforeseen expenses, vendor tips, weather safeguards

cost_saving_ideas.title: Direct Farm / Mandi Flower Sourcing
cost_saving_ideas.description: Procure focal flowers directly from Jaipur's wholesale wholesale flower market at early dawn instead of markup florists.
cost_saving_ideas.tradeoff: Requires transport coordination on the morning of setup.

cost_saving_ideas.title: Streamlined Seasonal Culinary Menu
cost_saving_ideas.description: Focus on 18 deeply flavorful, chef-signature dishes rather than an unmanageable 50-dish buffet that generates waste.
cost_saving_ideas.tradeoff: Fewer redundant side dishes, but vastly fresher presentation.

cost_saving_ideas.title: Digital Motion Video Invites with RSVP Portal
cost_saving_ideas.description: Use interactive mobile invites with calendar sync buttons instead of bulky printed cards.
cost_saving_ideas.tradeoff: No physical paper card, but instantaneous guest RSVP tracking.

what_to_ask: What is the hard outdoor sound curfew time?
Is there a dedicated backup generator included for stage AV?
What are the parking capacity and valet arrangements?
what_to_confirm: Access window for morning decor setup (minimum 4 hours before event)
Bridal/VIP green room availability with air conditioning and lockable storage
Security guards and perimeter management staff
negotiation_tips: Ask for venue cleanup and basic power surcharge fees to be waived
Negotiate complimentary overnight storage for leftover gifts or decor props
red_flags: Unwillingness to provide a written rain/weather emergency backup hall
Strict penalties without refund clauses for government-mandated curfew shifts
vendor_checklists.draft_inquiry_message: Hello! We are planning a 150-guest wedding in Jaipur on 2026-11-20. We would love to enquire about venue availability, hall rental packages, sound limits, and catering guidelines. Please share your brochure and booking terms.

what_to_ask: Can you accommodate our veg dietary preferences with dedicated separate cooking stations?
What is your dedicated waitstaff-to-guest ratio?
Do you supply food warmers, chafing dishes, and eco-friendly crockery?
what_to_confirm: Scheduled pre-booking menu tasting session for 3-4 decision makers
Freshness guarantee and safe disposal protocols for remaining food
Live cooking station fire safety compliance
negotiation_tips: Request complimentary welcome drink mocktails or tea/coffee counters
Negotiate free plate count for children under 6 years
red_flags: Refusal to let client inspect their central commercial kitchen
Vague pricing that excludes serving staff or ice bucket charges
vendor_checklists.draft_inquiry_message: Namaste! We are seeking an exceptional catering partner for a 150-guest wedding on 2026-11-20 in Jaipur. Our dietary requirement is veg. Please share sample menus and tasting options.

what_to_ask: How many photographers and cinematographers will be present on-site?
What is the turnaround time for teaser photos vs full edited cinematic film?
Do you carry backup camera bodies and dual SD-card slot equipment?
what_to_confirm: Delivery of high-resolution uncompressed digital gallery link
Drone flight permissions in the venue's airspace
Specific shot list (family portraits, candid moments, decor details)
negotiation_tips: Include a 60-second teaser reel for social media within 48 hours
Bundle pre-event photoshoot into the total contract
red_flags: No physical contract or unclear delivery date SLA (over 90 days)
Subcontracting the actual shoot to junior freelancers unknown to you
